svg.title: Controls follow consequences
svg.desc: A comparison register of work classes and proportionate controls, not a maturity sequence. System model: Controls follow consequences. Throwaway Discard cheaply; keep it reversible. Experiment Retain useful observations. Project Protect source and history. Product Observe real use. Commercial Protect money and commitments Bound authority and fulfilment. Treasured Restrict access to what must stay private. Classes, not stages. Choose proportionate controls for the actual consequence; no maturity or progress is implied.
